fixtures.description: Normative v1 conventions for help, version, dispatch failures, output modes, common and persistent flags, and env passthrough, on one fixture CLI.
The single-dash long-flag rewrite rules and exceptions: bare, inline and separate values, shorthand clusters, value-taking shorthands, bare --, and NoInterspersed stop rules.
A declaration with bareHelp set: a bare invocation prints the root help and exits 0.
The declared exit-code vocabulary: a handler returns a declared code and it wins over the usage/operational split.
Signal exits on a declaration that carries a long-running command: SIGINT exits 130 and SIGTERM exits 143 with no stdout result.
